english.title: Not being a member of M.O.D. Police wear an article of uniform calculated to deceive
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being a member of the Ministry of Defence Police, wore an article of the uniform of the Ministry of Defence Police, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), in circumstances where it gave you an appearance so nearly resembling that of a member as to be calculated to deceive
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2) of the Ministry of Defence Police Act 1987.
